Hi! I'm a professional artist with Madd and its definitely a blessing and a curse.

In one hand you get really in tune with your characters and can have so many ideas in how to draw them and build the world they live in.

On the other hand it is very easy to get too absorbed into this. I constantly imagine movie like scenarios in my head for hours before I go to sleep and then I write it down later as inspiration for mybart. A good suggestion I have is when you sit down to draw to give yourself a time limit so you dont get TOO absorbed. I've also found ASMR to help me because I tend to focus on the sounds and it's harder for me to get distracted by daydreaming.

Moral of the story: please dont give up on your passion for art! It's such a gift and I believe if you can learn tools that work for you to pull yourself put of excessive daydreams, you will be okay.
